claim: DYWORD struct: byte offset 0 is DYWST0, the start column for GA1 tiers 0-3 (a signed word) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:202).
DYWORD struct: byte offset 2 is DYWST1, the start column for GA1 tiers 4-6 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:203).
DYWORD struct: byte offset 4 is DYWST2, the start column for GA1 tiers 7-9 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:204).
DYWORD struct: byte offset 6 is DYWEND, the signed word end/plateau value the walk clamps at (JOUSTRV4.SRC:205).
DYWORD struct: byte offset 8 is DYWTIM, five bytes = ten nibbles of per-difficulty step-cadence times before the next adjustment (JOUSTRV4.SRC:206).

source.verbatim: DYWTIM	RMB	5	NIBBLE TIMES BEFORE NEXT ADJUSTMENTS

claim: DYWORD struct: byte offset 13 is DYWINC, the signed byte per-step increment (JOUSTRV4.SRC:207).
DYWORD struct: DYWLEN closes the row at 14 bytes (RMB 0 caps the field layout) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:208).
The DYWORD macro takes eight operands START1,START2,START3,INCRE,ENDV,TIM1,TIM2,TIM3 — INCRE is the FOURTH operand (JOUSTRV4.SRC:210).
The DYWORD macro emits FDB START1,START2,START3,ENDV,TIM1,TIM2 — six big-endian words, twelve bytes (JOUSTRV4.SRC:211).
The DYWORD macro emits FCB TIM3,INCRE last — so INCRE, the 4th operand, is the 14th and LAST byte, not the 4th (JOUSTRV4.SRC:212).
DYTBL is the label of the dynamic-intelligence difficulty table (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7303); the 28 DYWORD rows run JOUSTRV4.SRC:7304-7331.
DYTBL row 1 (LAVTIM) = DYWORD $000B,$0006,$0004,-01,$0001,$FA86,$4433,$21: three tier starts 11/6/4, inc -1, end 1 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7304).
DYEND EQU * terminates DYTBL; the table is 28 DYWORD rows (JOUSTRV4.SRC:7304-7331), 392 bytes, ending at JOUSTRV4.SRC:7332.
GA1 (operator difficulty) is read via RCMSA to pick the DYTBL start column (JOUSTRV4.SRC:930).
GA1 0,1,2,3 → start-column offset 0 (CMPA #3 / BLS keeps offset 0) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:933).
GA1 4,5,6 → start-column offset 1; GA1 7+ → offset 2 (CMPA #6 / BLS, the second INC) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:936).
The GA1 7+ tier increments the start offset a second time to select DYWST2 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:938).
The DYTBL start-value init walks the table (LDX #DYTBL) seeding the RAM working copy (JOUSTRV4.SRC:939).
DYNADJ is the RAM working copy of DYTBL, stepped once per wave (JOUSTRV4.SRC:940).
The per-entry countdown timer is seeded to 2 at difficulty init (LDA #2 / STA 2,Y) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:945).
IWAVE (the inter-wave difficulty pass) reads GA1 as the difficulty level for the walk (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1890).
IWAVE gates each entry on its DYNADJ+2 countdown timer — steps only when the timer reaches zero (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1895).

source.verbatim: 2$	LDB	2,Y		TIME TO CHANGE THE VALUE?

claim: The per-difficulty nibble byte offset is DYWTIM*2 + level, then ASRB (the level LSB selects the nibble half) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1900).

source.verbatim: ADDB	#DYWTIM*2	GET OFFSET FOR TIME TABLE

claim: The step-cadence value is the masked low nibble (ANDB #$0F) of the selected DYWTIM byte (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1908).
The per-step increment is the signed byte DYWINC (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1910), sign-extended (SEX) before the add.
Each step adds the increment then compares the new value against DYWEND (CMPD DYWEND,X) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1914).
On reaching/passing DYWEND the value is clamped to DYWEND (LDD DYWEND,X) — the plateau (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1921).
IWAVE advances one DYWORD row per entry by DYWLEN (LEAX DYWLEN,X) across all 28 rows (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1923).
The lava-level step (retrofit): SAFRAM raises the lava once per wave inside the same IWAVE pass (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1929).

source.verbatim: LDA	SAFRAM		RASIE LAVA IF POSSIBLE

claim: The lava stops rising at the $E0 floor (CMPA #$E0 / BLS): the sequence is $EA → $E5 → $E0 (JOUSTRV4.SRC:1930).
The pursuit-nibble budget seed (retrofit) masks the wave-row persue value to its low nibble (ANDA #$0F) (JOUSTRV4.SRC:2076).
The masked pursuit nibble is stored to WSMART as the intelligence-budget seed (JOUSTRV4.SRC:2077).
The EMYTIM divider (retrofit) is set to 2 on the 1st/2nd wave to slow the enemy (JOUSTRV4.SRC:2205).

source.verbatim: STA	EMYTIM		SLOW DOWN THE ENEMY ONLY!
